id.description: The unique identifier for the order

customerOrderReference.description: Your reference you specified when creating the order

createdDate.description: The date the order was created, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

phoneNumberQuantity.description: The number of phone numbers in the order, a helper property for you, this can also be done by and counting on the `numbers` collection

focQuantity.description: The number of phone numbers that are confirmed, a helper property for you, this can also be done by and counting on the `numbers` collection and  filtering on status `CONFIRMED`

activatedQuantity.description: The number of phone numbers that are activated, The number of phone numbers that are confirmed, a helper property for you, this can also be done by and counting on the `numbers` collection and  filtering on status `COMPLETE`

rejectedQuantity.description: The number of phone numbers that are rejected, This can be done by counting on the `phoneNumbers` collection and  filtering on status `REJECTED`

excludedQuantity.description: The number of phone numbers that are activated, The number of phone numbers that are confirmed, a helper property for you, this can also be done by and counting on the `numbers` collection and filtering on status `EXCLUDED`

OrderStatus.description: The current status of the port order.

x-enumDescriptions.PENDING: The order is pending, and can be updated
x-enumDescriptions.CONFIRMED: The order is confirmed, and can not be updated but if onDemand is true it can be activated
x-enumDescriptions.COMPLETED: The order is completed, the port has completed and the numbers are active
x-enumDescriptions.CANCELED: The order is cancelled, either by the customer or by the system
